analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($117.92) vs SMA5($117.27)/SMA20($133.18)/SMA50($143.44): Attempted short-term rise but remains below mid-term MAs.
· Position vs SMA100($145.03)/SMA200($134.40): Below long-term MAs, in bearish territory.
· 52-week position (42.2%) + Approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (36.2 → 38.2): Attempted to exit oversold but failed, lingering at the lower end of neutral.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.9790 → -1.9695): Bearish momentum persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $109.97, Middle $133.18): Approaching lower band, 34.86% band width suggests potential volatility expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($114.63): Based on 20-day low; further decline possible if breached.
· Swing Resistance ($118.97): Based on 5-day high; short-term rebound expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Potential Lower Low): Suggests continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.62): Low conviction in price movement, deferring directional judgment.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Failed to meet buy entry conditions due to RSI rebound failure and MACD deterioration; maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가 대비 현재가 위치 및 20일 저가 대비 5일 저가 패턴으로 볼 때, 명확한 Higher Low 패턴 미형성. MACD 악화 지속으로 Lower High 가능성 열려 있음.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Based on the current price relative to the 5-day low and the 5-day low pattern relative to the 20-day low, a clear Higher Low pattern is not formed. With continued MACD deterioration, the possibility of a Lower High remains open.
keyPoints: RSI 38.2로 과매도 구간 탈출 실패, 5일 전 36.2 대비 소폭 상승에 그침

ADX 27.9로 추세 강도 유지되나, -DI(38.4)가 +DI(13.7) 대비 3배 이상 높아 하락 압력 우위
keyPointsEn: RSI at 38.2 failed to exit oversold, only a slight increase from 36.2 five days ago.
MACD histogram worsened to -1.9695, widening the decline from -0.9790 five days ago.
ADX at 27.9 maintains trend strength, but -DI (38.4) is over 3x +DI (13.7), indicating downside pressure dominance.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 27.9로 추세 강도는 있으나, -DI 우위와 거래량 위축으로 인한 급락 가능성 경계 구간.
analysis.riskNoteEn: While ADX at 27.9 indicates trend strength, caution is advised due to the risk of a sharp decline stemming from -DI dominance and low volume.
analysis.continuity: 직전 2거래일 연속 관망 판독 유지. 금일 RSI 38.2로 과매도 구간 탈출 시도했으나 실패, MACD 히스토그램 악화 지속으로 관망 판독 유지.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past two consecutive trading sessions. Today, RSI attempted to exit oversold at 38.2 but failed, and MACD histogram deterioration continued, thus maintaining the wait-and-see read.
